September 29, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-29-1971-54702

Pakistan government requests UN Secretary General to ban MR Siddiqui’s entry permit in UN secretariat.

British Labour Party’s Secretary Timothy Reid Escott sends a letter to Justice Abu Sayed Chowdhury requesting him to join the party’s conference in October.

A government notice in Rawalpindi says that 20 people have given testimonies against Sheikh Mujib in front of a special tribunal.

Governor Malik sits with the cabinet at the secretariat. They decide to cut off another five to ten percent of their remuneration to help Pakistan in “hard time”.
